lines.zh: 水推我一下，我就走一段。
lines.en: The water pushes once, and I drift a while.

lines.zh: 八条胳膊一起划，很省力。
lines.en: Eight arms rowing together make it easy.
I swim slowly; the water carries me.
I follow the cold current; it is clean there.
At the river mouth, I can taste the salt.
I glide just above the sandy bottom.
The deep is dark, and my eyes are enough.
A little higher, and the light returns.

lines.zh: 我缩一下身子，弹出好远。
lines.en: I squeeze my body and shoot far ahead.

lines.zh: 八条触手一起拨开海草。
lines.en: All eight arms push the seagrass aside.

lines.zh: 这一层水，正是我住的地方。
lines.en: This layer of water is exactly my home.

lines.zh: 我拐个弯，躲开那块礁石。
lines.en: I turn aside and avoid that reef.
Sinking lower, and lower, everything goes quiet.
The tide goes east, so I go east.

lines.zh: 我把触手并拢，像一根梭子。
lines.en: I gather my tentacles into one shuttle.
The river bends south; so do I.
The water turns slowly around me.
I float here unmoving, and that is fine.
A boat's shadow passes above me.
Something is crawling in the sand.
I blow a bubble and watch it rise.
I know this taste of salt well.
Cold water flowing over me feels good.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊开，像一片影。
lines.en: I spread myself out like a shadow.
A school of fish passes, and I stay still.
A muffled sound rolls up from the deep.
My tentacles move without being told.

lines.zh: 光从水面漏下来，一条一条。
lines.en: Light leaks down through the surface in strips.
I wait for the tide to turn.
It is so quiet I hear my fins moving.
You dive down and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 你的面罩后面有两只眼睛。
lines.en: Behind your mask there are two eyes.
You are bigger than fish, and slower.
Are you here to catch me? I back away.
Your lamp makes me look pale.
You breathe out underwater, a string of bubbles.
I know those boots; they are heavy.
Your hand comes near, so I pull my arms in.
Do not touch me; I will spit ink.
Your eyes follow me as I drift.
I spat out a huge cloud of ink.
Do not pull my tentacles!
It hurts; I have curled into a ball.
The water went black all at once.

lines.zh: 谁碰我？我连方向都乱了。
lines.en: Who touched me? I have lost my direction.
One of my arms is shorter now.
Let me sink; do not follow me down.
That nearly flipped me upside down.
I blow bubbles and retreat backwards.
Do not grab; I am very slippery.
You dangle dried fish, but I have no hands.
Fish? I eat small ones, and chase no big ones.
Drop the food; the bubbles will scatter it.
I follow the current, not people.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，不值得我过去。
lines.en: Those crumbs are not worth the swim.
You sway about like some large fish.

lines.zh: 我在等水里自己漂来的东西。
lines.en: I wait for whatever drifts to me.
Do not use a net; I will dodge it.

lines.zh: 你的饵沉下来了，我不碰。
lines.en: Your bait is sinking; I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 我对亮的东西感兴趣，不是食物。
lines.en: Bright things catch my eye, not food.
You scattered the ink I just released.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的触手太长了。
lines.en: Sorry, my tentacles are too long.
The water is crowded; let us separate.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你会摸到滑滑的。
lines.en: Touch me and you will feel something slippery.
I will sink deeper; you go on past.
Your knee just bumped into me.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我喷了一小口墨。
lines.en: That bump made me release a little ink.
Do not crowd this side of the reef.
I wrapped around your foot; I am sorry.

lines.zh: 水流把我们推到一起了。
lines.en: The current pushed us into each other.
You have more spots on you than I do.
We swim side by side and take it slow.
Warm shallows are good for laying eggs.

lines.zh: 我们把卵一串串挂上海草。
lines.en: We hang our eggs in strings on the seagrass.
No rush; let us follow the tide first.

lines.zh: 这一片海，够养很多小的。
lines.en: This patch of sea can raise many little ones.
Your color is pale, and very pretty.

lines.zh: 我们往暖水去，那里安全。
lines.en: Let us go to the warm water; it is safer there.
The eggs must be stuck into rock crevices.
You swim ahead, and I will follow.
I curl a tentacle around it.
What sinks down here belongs to me.
This shell I will carry back with me.
I cannot hold it; it is too slippery.
I touch it with the tip of an arm.

lines.zh: 它沉得比我快，我追上去。
lines.en: It sinks faster than me, so I chase it.
Little thing, I will carry you curled up.
This bright little piece, I like it.
I hide it underneath my tentacles.
Do not grab it; it drifted to me.
A shadow is pressing down from above.
That big thing is looking at me.
I pull my arms in and prepare to flee.
That is not food; that is danger.
The water shakes; something is chasing.
It blocks the way to deeper water.
I keep my eyes on it and back away.
A net is dropping from the boat above.
I cannot go that way.
It is faster than me; I need a crevice.
It is still coming; I count its approach.
My ink sac is full and ready.
One step closer and I will spray.
Every one of my arms is drawn tight.

lines.zh: 它比我快，我得躲进石头缝。
lines.en: It is quicker than me; I must reach the rocks.
The moment the water stirs, I move.
I watch its hands, not its face.
It waits, and so do I.

lines.zh: 退到暗处，它就看不见我。
lines.en: Back into the dark, where it cannot see me.
I have muddied this mouthful of water.
Ink! Let all of it out!
This black cloud will keep you guessing.
I am not attacking; I am escaping.
One whip of my arms; stop grabbing.
The water is black now; you cannot find me.
Come closer and I will spray again.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己也吓了一跳。
lines.en: That surprised even me.
My ink is thick and clears very slowly.
Back away and I will stop spraying.
Sorry for the ink all over your face.

lines.zh: 我在这一层水里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in this layer of water.
Cold, deep, and just right.
Far above my head there is light.
The first thing I do is release ink.

lines.zh: 这里的水是咸的，我喜欢。
lines.en: The water here is salty, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，触手先动。
lines.en: I left the egg, arms moving first.

lines.zh: 身边有很多同伴，都在游。
lines.en: Many of my kind are swimming all around.

lines.zh: 河底的石头上，我出生了。
lines.en: I was born on the stones of the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我还没学会躲，先学会飘。
lines.en: I have not learned to hide, only to drift.
This stretch of sea, I will learn slowly.

lines.zh: 水外有火，我的皮在收紧。
lines.en: Fire outside the water makes my skin tighten.
I hit the sand and my arms splay out.
Out of the water, I cannot draw anything in.

lines.zh: 水里炸开，我被推得好远。
lines.en: The water burst, and I was thrown far.
Something cut through the water and struck me.

lines.zh: 一股麻从触手爬到身上。
lines.en: A numbness climbs from my arms through my body.

lines.zh: 饿得我连墨都喷不出来。
lines.en: Too hungry to even spit a cloud of ink.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water and shook my whole body.
The water is gone and I tumble in emptiness.
